description: FULL BODY: A 60-year-old Malaysian woman of Malay ethnicity. She has a gentle face with visible worry lines. She is wearing a modest floral print baju kurung in soft blue and a simple cream-colored tudung (hijab). She wears small gold spectacles and black leather sandals.

FULL BODY: An anonymous human-shaped figure acting as a scammer. The figure is a featureless dark silhouette with glowing blue circuitry lines running across its body like a digital network. It wears a translucent, glitchy business suit overlay to mimic a professional appearance.

FULL BODY: A 40-year-old Malaysian man of Malay ethnicity. He has a neat, short haircut and a professional demeanor. He is wearing the formal dark blue uniform of the Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM), complete with silver insignia on the shoulders, a utility belt, and polished black tactical boots.
